title: Alagoas state government website intruded with a valid administrator login; content deleted, site offline six days
date_note: Cada Minuto (published 26 November) says the intrusion began on the night of Thursday 19 November; the page's own day is used as the page gives no later disclosure day.
geo_basis: state government as named by the source; no city given, state centre used
summary: Cada Minuto reports that an intruder who began acting at 23h17 on Thursday 19 November used valid administrator login and password to enter the Alagoas government website, change its homepage and delete news, event and gallery content. After six days offline the site returned on a new platform, but the content is not all restored. The government says in a note that no information was lost.
plain: Cada Minuto reports an intruder used a valid administrator login to alter and delete content on the Alagoas government site. It was offline six days and not all content is back; the government says no information was lost.
exec: A state government website was offline for six days after an intruder used a valid administrator login, Cada Minuto reports; content is still being restored.

validation.note: Only Cada Minuto was read; Itec's and the government's statements are as quoted there. No independent publisher or Itec page was read.
